QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Of Wu Tien Mountain
QuestInfo.0: The master will tell you about a new place to train, called Wu Tien Mountain. Talk to the master.
QuestInfo.1: The master will tell you about a new place to train, called Wu Tien Mountain. Talk to the master.
QuestInfo.2: The master told you of Wu Tien Mountain, located just behind Mu Lung. He said that mountain is where masters have trained for generations. Even from afar it looks tall and treacherous. The perfect challenge for you!
